name: Helena
message: 「It looks like you've collected over 10 trophies」

name: Helena
message: 「On a celebratory occasion like this, we just have to throw a big party\s07」

name: Helena
message: 「So, let's get the drinking party started right now!」

name: Helena
message: 「Hm? What is it? Here I am offering to praise you, and you actually have a complaint?」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh, really? That's right, there's no way you could have any complaints!」

name: Helena
message: 「I-It's not like I just wanted an excuse to drink alcohol or anything!」

name: Helena
message: 「Well then, forget just one drink--why don't you keep me company all night long\s04」

name: Helena
message: 「Wait, right, alcohol is a no-go because you're underage?」

name: Helena
message: 「I think if we drank in secret, nobody would find out unless we told them, though...」

name: Helena
message: 「Well, it can't be helped, so just watch closely as I get all tipsy and alluring from the drinks\s04」

name: Helena
message: 「I won't let you escape until I'm satisfied\s07」

name: Helena
message: 「Nfufu... At this rate, I'd be happy if you completed the rest of the trophies too」

name: Helena
message: 「I'm cheering you on! Well then, cheers♪」
